7Method & capability

How the study was done.

Two UK panels were fielded simultaneously for the 2026 World Cup Brand Tracker Wave 1.

  • Opinion Pulse: UK general public, n=244.
  • Voice of the Trade: verified UK tradespeople, n=116.
  • Fieldwork: 5–10 June 2026. Online interviewing.
  • Results are unweighted percentages of the responding base for each question. Multi-code questions sum to more than 100%.
  • Sub-bases under ~30 are flagged as Indicative and should be read directionally.
  • Every figure on this page is computed directly from the raw response file (one row per respondent), filtered by panel and demographic, not from pre-summarised tables.

Wave 2 will follow during and after the tournament for tracking on awareness, engagement, and behaviour shift.
